{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_ids: {df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check assay_batch
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check sample_seq distribution
df_sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {df_sample_seq_max[df_sample_seq_max > 1].count()}')"}
